exposure: Type of incision (infra-umbilical vs. modified intra-umbilical)
outcome: Tightness of the primary portal entry
finding: A modified, curved, deep, bidirectional, intra-umbilical, vertical incision for primary trocar insertion in laparoscopy resulted in less peri-trocar CO2 leakage, a tighter primary portal entry, and better cosmetic outcomes at 1-month follow-up compared to an infra-umbilical incision.
